title: Population–Molecular Cancer Digital Twin for oral nicotine pouches: figure-generation code and framework pseudocode
description:
Graphviz sources and Python scripts that regenerate every figure in the article Artificial intelligence–enabled digital twins for forecasting cancer burden from oral nicotine pouches: a review and expert opinion (submitted to AI Biology & Medicine), together with the framework pseudocode, sample data schema, and validation and reproducibility checklists from its Supplementary Methods.

The article proposes a hypothesis-generating framework. No model was fitted to real data; the data-style figures plot synthetic placeholder values that illustrate output structure only.
